pattern: People-analytics export → Azure Data Factory → blob staging → Snowflake

stages.title: People-analytics export
stages.body: A scheduled extract. The cut the board is allowed to see — not a warehouse tour.

stages.title: Azure Data Factory
stages.body: The factory owns the clock. Copy, light type, fail in run history instead of a personal inbox.

stages.title: Blob staging
stages.body: Latest file wins. BI and the board never open the live system of record.

stages.title: Snowflake
stages.body: The warehouse the live board and, if you want it, Power BI both read. Same as-of.
